package main

import (
	"fmt"
)

type Option[T any] struct {
	ok  bool
	val T
}

func (o Option[T]) String() string {
	if o.ok {
		return fmt.Sprintf("Some(%v)", o.val)
	}
	return "None"
}

func Some[T any](val T) Option[T] { return Option[T]{ok: true, val: val} }

func main() {
	a := Some[int](1)
	b := Option[int]{}
	fmt.Println(a, b)
}
